name: Disrespect
overview: Scripture teaches that disrespect is contrary to God's will, as shown by the call to worship God alone and serve Him faithfully rather than yielding to temptation (Matthew 4:10). Believers are encouraged to live peaceably with others as much as possible (Romans 12:18) and to obey authority, such as children obeying their parents, which pleases the Lord (Colossians 3:20). At the same time, Christians must reject and reprove unfruitful works of darkness (Ephesians 5:11) while renewing their minds to discern and live according to God's perfect will (Romans 12:2). Faithfulness and wise stewardship in relationships also reflect God’s standards for respectful conduct (Luke 12:42).
